title: Codex review clarification result
description: One clarification for a single finding. Deliberately has no executor-brief field: the reviewer names the repair direction and stops.

fingerprint.description: The single finding fingerprint being clarified. Exactly one per clarification.

repair_direction.description: Direction of repair only. Not an executor brief, not a patch, not an approval.

evidence.description: Probe output, identifiers, and exact error strings preserved verbatim.

still_unbounded.description: True when the finding still cannot become a bounded repair after this clarification. The orchestrator treats this as a circuit-breaker trigger.

behavior.description: How the invariant breaks along this path.

proves.description: What the named test proves. It must be able to fail before the repair.
